title: Find Chai-1
story: Chai-1 predicts the structure of proteins together with ligands, DNA and RNA. On Geiss-01 it's installed in a conda environment called chai, and its command is `chai-lab`. Switch the environment on, then read the help for `chai-lab fold` to find how many structures (diffusion samples) it makes by default. Type the number in the answer box.

tasks.text: Read the help for chai-lab fold
How many samples does it make by default?

hints: `module load anaconda` gives you `conda`; `conda activate chai` switches the environment on.
`chai-lab --help` lists the subcommands; `chai-lab fold --help` lists the options for folding.
